sentence: A comparable gap opens up a little over two centuries after Saenredam's Haarlem interiors, in photography, where [close examination of the plate](/daguerreotype/) usually credited with capturing the first photographed person turned up faint traces, a possible child, a horse, other unregistered smears, that complicate the tidy single-bystander story built around the image's most legible corner.
